github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Format: type(scope): summary — all lowercase, imperative mood, no trailing period, one line unless the diff spans genuinely unrelated concerns.

type is one of: feat (new content/capability), fix (correction to existing content/code), rewrite (rework of existing prose/logic, not a fix or new feature), docs (skill/doc-only changes), chore (tooling/config, no content change).

scope is the narrowest accurate AREA or CONCERN the diff touches — never the filename itself and never the word 'test'/'testing'/'file'/'files' as a scope. Pick one of: a language code (es, en, ar...) when the change is confined to one language's files; a feature/domain name (image-validation, image-prompts, index, encounters, discovery, validation, settings) when it spans files but stays in one concern; a comma-separated list (discovery,encounters) only when the same fix genuinely applies to both corpora. If nothing in that list fits, invent the shortest domain word a reviewer would recognize (e.g. 'scripts', 'schema') — do not fall back to the bare filename or its basename.

Reject and regenerate if: scope equals or contains a filename/extension (e.g. 'dummy_test_file', 'index.json'), scope is a generic placeholder ('test', 'misc', 'general', 'stuff'), type doesn't match the actual change (don't use 'chore' for content changes or 'feat' for a bugfix), or the summary just restates the type+scope without saying what changed (e.g. 'chore(settings): update settings' is invalid — say what about settings changed).

summary states the concrete change, not a vague verb — name what was added/fixed/removed and, when the diff alone wouldn't make the reason obvious, append ' — <why>' after the summary (e.g. 'trim man_born_blind_001 subtitle to avoid spoiling the key verse'). Do not write generic filler like 'update files' or 'improve code' — say what changed.

Examples from this repo's own history to match: 'feat(image-validation): add format validation for resolved image URLs', 'fix(index): update intro_image for man_born_blind entry and refine image prompt description', 'rewrite(image-prompts): raise craft to match published corpus (widow_nain, gadarene, nicodemus)', 'fix(discovery,encounters): replace target-script phonetic respellings with Latin transliteration'.
